title: "Beyond the AI Hype"
subtitle: "What Really Matters"

A weekly thought-leadership series hosted by Dr. Amobi Andrew Onovo, exploring what actually makes AI useful, responsible, equitable and effective.

## Core promise

Every episode starts with a common assumption, challenges it using a relatable scenario, and ends with a practical question for leaders, teams and communities.

## Episode 01: Automation ≠ Transformation

*When we automate a broken process, we don't necessarily solve the problem. Sometimes, we simply make it happen faster.*

If reporting moves from three days to three minutes but the data are incomplete and no one acts on the findings, the problem remains.

**Before asking what we can automate, ask what we should change.**

The digital-twin presentation is planned; no video has been published or embedded here yet.

## Planned themes

- More Data ≠ Better Decisions
- AI Adoption ≠ AI Impact
- Human-in-the-Loop ≠ Human-in-Control
- Accuracy ≠ Trustworthiness
- AI Skills ≠ AI Literacy
